vertebrae.extractors.onnx
=========================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.extractors.onnx

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Optional ONNX runtime feature extractor.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.extractors.onnx.ONNXExtractor


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: ONNXExtractor(name, model_path, input_fn = None, output_fn = None, input_names = None, output_names = None, providers = None, provider_options = None, modality = 'unknown', extractor_type = 'custom_onnx', recipe_data = None, allow_sparse = False, streaming_safe = True)

   Wrap a local ONNX model as a feature extractor.

   :param name: User-facing extractor name.
   :param model_path: Path to a local ONNX model file.
   :param input_fn: Optional callable that converts raw inputs into ONNX inputs.
   :param output_fn: Optional callable that converts raw ONNX outputs into embeddings.
   :param input_names: Optional ONNX input names to feed. Defaults to the model inputs.
   :param output_names: Optional ONNX output names to fetch. Defaults to the model outputs.
   :param providers: Optional ONNX Runtime execution providers.
   :param provider_options: Optional provider-specific configuration dictionaries.
   :param modality: Input modality metadata.
   :param extractor_type: Extractor family metadata.
   :param recipe_data: Extra serializable metadata for reproducibility.
   :param allow_sparse: Whether sparse embedding outputs are allowed.
   :param streaming_safe: Whether independent batches can be embedded without full-context state.


   .. py:method:: fit(X, y = None)

      No-op fit for frozen ONNX models.



   .. py:method:: transform(X)

      Run the ONNX model and validate the resulting embeddings.



   .. py:method:: fit_transform(X, y = None)

      Run the ONNX model and return validated embeddings.



   .. py:method:: recipe()

      Return a serializable ONNX extractor recipe.
